In detail

Grouped with neighbouring Prądnik Czerwony in the 2022 police breakdown as the pairing with the city's highest recorded sexual-offence count (8) and highest vehicle-theft count (19) of any district grouping that year. The 2020 Otodom resident-safety survey rated it 3.70/5, a middling score. No specific 2025-2026 incident coverage was found for this district beyond the figures above. Sources checked: Portal Samorządowy (2022 police district data); Otodom District Ranking 2020.
